sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: "Check title style" is now where you see it: an Aa button next to the filters, in the filter bar after Cc / Rx / Ex on a page with one table, and in every sub-table heading on a page with several. It checks the whole page, as the ⚠️ list's row does, which stays. Afterwards each button shows its own table's result, "Aa 4 titles off-style ▾" in amber or a green "✓ Style OK". Clicking it (or resting on it) opens a small panel: titles checked, time taken, the five title-style warnings with their counts — a warning found on the page is a white box with a checkbox and its count in a pill, one found nowhere is greyed out — ticked to show only those rows in every table (the ⚠️ list shows the same tick), the table's titles struck through over their MusicBrainz style (click one to go to its row), and the "Check every page by itself" switch. Esc or a click outside closes it.

A short hint under the first Aa button, a moment after a page with unchecked titles renders, offers the check: Check now, Always check, or Not now. It closes by itself after 14 seconds, on Esc, or on a click anywhere else; "Don’t show this again" stops it (new setting: ⚠️ Findings → Offer the title-style check in a hint).
